name: registers
character: cinematic and natural are not adjectives, they are two measurable ways of putting a piece in a room. A register is a band of dynamic range, reverb, width, sync and loudness; a piece declares one and the gate checks it was delivered.

cinematic.character: the music is larger than the room: long tails, wide image, hits that land on the picture, a big distance between the quiet and the loud
sources: references/mixing/mixing-and-mastering.md section 3 (film/cinematic loudness and large_hall 3.2 s)

natural.character: the music is in the room with the player: one space, dynamics preserved, no hit tied to a cut, tempo allowed to breathe

documentary.character: a bed that must never take the narration's place: narrow, low, almost no accents

diegetic.character: the sound is the source on screen: a radio, a band in the next room, a phone speaker. It is filtered by its own container and has no cinematic tail

hybrid.character: a diegetic source that opens into the score when the scene needs it; the register changes at a declared time, not gradually

provenance.registers.*.lra_lu: starting value: a band wide enough to separate a cue from a natural room bed; calibrate on the first measured renders
provenance.registers.cinematic.reverb_tail_s: the large_hall figure in mixing-and-mastering.md section 3 (3.2 s) as the centre of the band
provenance.registers.*.lufs: the delivery rows in mixing-and-mastering.md section 3 (a band, not a target). intent.register_loudness takes the middle of the intersection of the bands a piece's registers declare, to half a LU, as the master loudness when the piece states none and chose no mastering profile (mix_engine/mastering._master_cfg); registers whose bands do not overlap give no target and the master keeps the shipped default of references/data/master_targets.json. A starting value: the band edges are not measurements of released cues.
provenance.registers.*.sync_to_picture: a definition, not a measurement: cinema is written against the cut, a natural room bed is not
